results.question: Dali je netko u zadnjih 7 dana spomenuo PHP?
results.model_expression: m.created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND m.content LIKE '%PHP%'
results.application_sql_preview:
SELECT m.id, m.content, m.created_at
FROM nb_messages m
JOIN nb_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id
WHERE c.owner_id = :authenticated_owner
  AND c.updated_at >= :retention_cutoff
  AND m.status = 'complete'
  AND (((m.created_at >= %s AND m.content LIKE %s)) AND m.role = %s)
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 20
